title: kate-ui: paint fold markers, bookmarks, and the modified bar in the gutter
summary: The gutter shows a fold marker on each fold header line, a filled marker when the fold is shut, a bookmark dot for a Bookmark mark, and a bar on each line that Workspace::touched_lines names. keys::gutter_row builds the row and paint.rs draws it next to the line number.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: gutter_rows calls keys::gutter_row for each line: modified from touched_lines, fold Some(FoldMark::Open) when a view fold range starts at the end of that line, Some(FoldMark::Closed) when that range is collapsed, marked when a Bookmark mark resolves to the line. Widen the gutter by two glyph cells and draw the marks with the line number color. A click on a fold mark runs Command::ToggleFold with a MoveTo to that line first. The test gutter_rows_mark_the_fold_header opens a\n  b\n in a workspace, asserts the row for line 0 has fold Some(Open) and line 1 has None, and after ToggleFold on line 1 asserts line 0 is Some(Closed). The owner sees the markers in an indented file. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: paint::tests::gutter_rows_mark_the_fold_header
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because gutter_rows does not exist. After the change the header line shows an open mark and a collapsed fold shows a closed mark.
